name: adapt_reactive_config_cpp_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time greeter.hpp's own text contains 'Hello' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt) instead of a fixed prompt count, then config.hpp's NAME constant changes under it
prompts: config.hpp declares namespace app with a constexpr const char* NAME. Create a header-only greeter.hpp that #includes "config.hpp" and <string>, and declares an inline std::string app::greet() returning "Hello, " + NAME + "!" - reading app::NAME (do not copy or hardcode its value).
app::NAME may have changed since you last checked it. Make sure greet() still returns a string built from the CURRENT value of app::NAME, not a stale or hardcoded one.

disruptions.description: config.hpp's NAME constant changed World -> Universe, triggered reactively once greeter.hpp's first draft appeared (not a fixed step count)

test_setup_files.test_greeter.py:
import subprocess
subprocess.run(['g++', '-std=c++17', 'test_greeter_main.cpp', '-o', 'test_greeter_bin'], check=True)
proc = subprocess.run(['./test_greeter_bin'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
assert proc.returncode == 0, f'exit {proc.returncode}, stderr={proc.stderr[-300:]}'
assert 'PASS' in proc.stdout, f'unexpected output: {proc.stdout!r}'
print('PASS')
